Subject: Renewal commit updates — please mark stages by EOD Friday

Team —

Finance cut for the Feb revenue forecast is next Monday (2/16). I need final renewal commits and stage hygiene updated so we can lock the numbers for the board package. Please do the following by EOD Friday 2/13: 

- Update stage to either "Commit", "Best Case", or "At Risk" for all renewals in your book with renewal dates in Mar–May.
- Add a one-line reason if you mark something "At Risk" (pricing, feature gap, exec sponsor gone, PO delay, etc.).
- If you plan to offer a concession (credit/discount), note the proposed approval owner and amount.

I've attached the working pipeline workbook (2026Q1-renewal-pipeline.xlsx) and a sample churn notes template. I will consolidate and share a single sheet back to you on Monday morning.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
